projects.title: AI Career Pilot
projects.problem: Helps students discover career paths and prepare using AI-driven insights.
projects.description: AI Career Pilot is a comprehensive, AI-powered platform designed to supercharge your career journey. By leveraging Google's Gemini LLM and advanced career assessment algorithms, it helps users discover their ideal career path, build professional resumes, generate tailored cover letters, find internships, and practice mock interviews with real-time AI feedback.
keyFeatures: Career discovery engine with a short assessment

projects.title: Ride Booking Web Application
projects.problem: Enables real-time ride booking and tracking similar to Uber.
projects.description: A full-stack Ride-booking application inspired by Uber. Built with the MERN stack and Google Maps APIs, RideNow enables users to book rides in real time while captains (drivers) accept and complete trips. It features live tracking & real-time navigation, OTP-secured confirmations and a modern responsive UI.
keyFeatures: Real-time ride & location tracking using Google Maps

projects.title: Virtual Chemistry Lab
projects.problem: Provides a safe virtual environment to perform chemistry experiments.
projects.description: Virtual Chemistry Lab is an interactive web-based platform that allows students to perform and visualize chemistry experiments in a simulated environment. It aims to enhance conceptual understanding through hands-on virtual experimentation without the need for a physical lab.
keyFeatures: Chemistry experiments included such as distillation, titration, salt-analysis

projects.title: AI Cookbook Mobile Application
projects.problem: Helps users generate recipes instantly using AI.
projects.description: CookBook AI is a feature-rich React Native app that leverages Google Gemini AI to instantly generate complete recipes from a user-provided dish name. Users can authenticate with Google via Clerk, browse recipes by category, explore the full global recipe feed, and manage their personal recipe collection — all with a beautiful dark/light theme toggle.

projects.title: RAG PDF Chat Pipeline
projects.problem: Enables intelligent conversations with PDF documents using semantic search and LLMs.
projects.description: A high-performance, production-ready Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system with a distributed architecture. Users can upload PDF documents and instantly chat with them — the system asynchronously processes documents using a BullMQ worker queue, stores semantic vector embeddings in Qdrant, and generates grounded answers with source citations using Google Gemini 2.5 Flash via LangChain. Secured with Clerk authentication and deployed with Docker.
keyFeatures: Asynchronous PDF ingestion via BullMQ and Redis queue
Semantic vector search powered by Qdrant
AI answers with automatic page-level source citations
Premium glassmorphic chat UI built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS

responsibilities: Developing mobile applications using React Native and Expo
